label: Historical backtest, not forward results
vs_published_research: Faber (2007, SSRN 962461) used monthly trend vs 10-month SMA on asset-class proxies and moved to T-bills when below the average. This paper test uses liquid ETF sleeves (SPY/EFA/IEF/VNQ/DBC), Yahoo dividend-adjusted prices, next-session-open fills after month-end signals (no same-close execution), BIL as the cash proxy, and 1.5× desk costs. Equal 20% sleeve caps match the five-asset equal-risk framing; the original write-up also discusses absolute momentum with cash, which we keep.
